title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier W/ Towel Bar | Antique Pewter | Solid Brass | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Towel Bar, Antique Pewter
description:
Clear counter clutter and keep towels within reach with a wall-mounted glass shelf designed for everyday bathroom organization in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. This traditional bathroom hardware piece combines three tiers of tempered, beveled-edged glass with solid brass hardware and an integrated towel bar for a clean, coordinated look.

Highlights:
- Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
• Keep hand towels or decorative towels ready on the integrated towel bar
• Maintain a streamlined look with concealed screw mounting hardware
• Coordinate with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures across your space

Specs & Installation:
• Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
• Overall size: 16 in L x 18 in H x 5 in W
• Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
• Weight capacity: 6 lb
• Mounting: wall mount
• Assembly: no assembly required
• Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
• Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
